1CRN: Water structure of a hydrophobic protein at atomic resolution. Pentagon rings of water molecules in crystals of crambin. Determined by X-ray crystallography at 1.5 A resolution. It holds 1 polymer entity. Classified as plant protein and plant seed protein. Published by Teeter, Proc Natl Acad Sci U S A, 1984 (doi:10.1073/pnas.81.19.6014).
